description: Twelve-panel composite of bright-field TEM micrographs (four columns x three rows) documenting substructural evolution in 3Cr steel with increasing engineering strain. Each panel carries a header strain label: (a-c) 3%, (d-f) 10%, (g-l) "LD". Scale bars: 500 nm in (a, b, c, d, f, g, k, l), 200 nm in (e, h), 100 nm in (i) and 10 nm in (j). Panels (a-i) and (k) contain red-ring indexed SAED insets labelled with reflections 200, 111, 1-11 and 000 about the [011] zone axis; (j) is a high-resolution lattice-fringe image and (l) a dark-field image, neither with an inset. Printed annotations: (a) "Dislocation multipoles" with a (111) trace line; (b) "Slip band" with a (11-1) trace; (c) "Slip band" bounded by (111) and (11-1) traces; (d) (111) trace only; (e) "Slip band" between (111) and (11-1) traces plus "Dislocation"; (g) "Dislocation"; (h) "Very fine slip band" with (111) trace; (i) "Deformation twinning"; (k) "Stacking Fault" marked by white arrows. The group shows deformation progressing from planar dislocation multipoles/slip bands at 3%, through denser intersecting (1-11)/(11-1) slip bands with high-density dislocation arrays at 10%, to very fine slip bands, nanometre-width deformation twins and stacking faults at LD.

observations.observation: The figure is a 4x3 grid of twelve TEM images of the same alloy at three strain levels, with printed header labels '3%' (a-c), '10%' (d-f) and 'LD' (g-l).
Scale bars are printed on every panel: 500 nm in (a), (b), (c), (d), (f), (g), (k) and (l); 200 nm in (e) and (h); 100 nm in (i) and 10 nm in (j).
Ten panels (a-i and k) contain inset selected-area electron diffraction patterns drawn with red circles around reflections labelled 200, 111, 1-11 and 000, consistent with an [011] zone axis.
Panel (a) is annotated 'Dislocation multipoles' and shows dislocations aligned along a planar band marked by a (111) trace line.
Panels (b) and (c) are annotated 'Slip band'; (c) shows two intersecting planar features bounded by (111) and (11-1) trace lines.
Panel (e) is annotated with both 'Slip band' and 'Dislocation' and has the smallest scale bar among the 10% panels (200 nm), indicating finer substructure at this strain.
Panels (i) and (k) are annotated 'Deformation twinning' and 'Stacking Fault' respectively, and both belong to the LD (near-failure) group.
The caption states the bright-field TEM images were taken along the [011]gamma zone axis of the FCC matrix phase and that the insets are selected area electron diffraction patterns.
The caption assigns the panels to strain groups: (a-c) 3%, (d-f) 10% and (g-l) close to final failure (LD).
The citing text states that at 3% strain dislocation slip is the main feature and that the [011](1-11) slip system in the grain has a Schmid factor of 0.52.
The citing text states that with strain accumulating to 10% the space between slip bands becomes narrower, the number of slip bands increases and the dislocation density increases (Fig. 6d-f).
The citing text states that the LD condition corresponds to 54% strain, with high-density dislocations, very fine slip bands, nanometre-width deformation twins and stacking faults.
The citing text claims deformation twins appear only in the vicinity of fracture surfaces, so their contribution to ductility and strain-hardening capacity is expected to be very limited.
One citing sentence refers to the twinning and stacking-fault panels as 'Fig. 7i-l' although the figure shown and its caption place them in Fig. 6i-l; the two readings disagree.

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM, 3% strain, 500 nm scale bar. Labelled 'Dislocation multipoles' with a white (111) trace line across planar slip band, plus an indexed SAED inset (200, 111, 1-11, 000; [011]).
Bright-field TEM, 3% strain, 500 nm scale bar. Labelled 'Slip band' with a (11-1) trace; dislocations constrained within a planar band; indexed SAED inset.
Bright-field TEM, 3% strain, 500 nm scale bar. Two intersecting planar features labelled 'Slip band' between (111) and (11-1) trace lines; indexed SAED inset.
Bright-field TEM, 10% strain, 500 nm scale bar. Dense parallel slip bands with a (111) trace line; indexed SAED inset.
Bright-field TEM, 10% strain, 200 nm scale bar. Labelled 'Slip band' between (111) and (11-1) traces and 'Dislocation'; high-density dislocation arrays; indexed SAED inset.
Bright-field TEM, 10% strain, 500 nm scale bar. Intersecting planar slip bands from different slip systems; no text annotation; indexed SAED inset.
Bright-field TEM, LD, 500 nm scale bar. Labelled 'Dislocation'; a dense, diffuse dislocation structure; indexed SAED inset.
Bright-field TEM, LD, 200 nm scale bar. Labelled 'Very fine slip band' with a (111) trace line; band spacing much narrower than at 10%; indexed SAED inset.
Bright-field TEM, LD, 100 nm scale bar. Labelled 'Deformation twinning'; several thin parallel bands with an indexed SAED inset.
High-resolution TEM lattice-fringe image, LD, 10 nm scale bar; no annotation and no diffraction inset.
Bright-field TEM, LD, 500 nm scale bar. Labelled 'Stacking Fault'; a series of white arrows mark parallel fringes; indexed SAED inset.
Dark-field TEM image, LD, 500 nm scale bar; bright parallel planar bands on a dark background; no inset or text label.

unreadable_items: Individual SAED inset spot labels are rendered very small; only the set {200, 111, 1-11, 000} and the [011] zone-axis annotation could be read reliably, not every spot in each inset
Panel (f): no printed annotation, so the specific slip systems illustrated there cannot be identified from the panel itself
Panel (j): no annotation or inset, so the crystallographic feature shown is not identified within the panel
